<thought>We need to list all possible precursor sets for the protected molecules given. The protection is a TMS ether formed from an alcohol and TMSOTf. Removing the O‑Si bond gives the original alcohol (same SMILES for all three cases) and the reagent TMSOTf (SMILES C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F). Therefore each protected molecule yields the same pair of precursors.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO\", \"C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F\"], [\"C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO\", \"C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F\"], [\"C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO\", \"C[Si](C)(C)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F\"]]</final_answer>
